pfr-historic-appraisal.title: FD2657 cost-effectiveness appraisal
pfr-historic-appraisal.locator: Table 2.1 (2011 cost base); Table 2.14 (printed p24); Figure 3.2
pfr-historic-appraisal.kind: B / D · Published modelled appraisal with expert assumptions
pfr-historic-appraisal.method: 2012 appraisal; automatic 90% / manual 77% reliability factors are assigned expert model inputs
pfr-historic-appraisal.limitations: Not observed product-specific damage savings or current quotes. These factors are not used to claim household effectiveness. A 0.6m resistance cutoff is a historical modelling boundary, not certification or a universal safe depth.

pfr-pathway-preference.title: Conditional pathway coverage preference
pfr-pathway-preference.method: Equal weighting of the set of relevant unaddressed mechanisms; union removes overlap. Low/central/high stress multipliers 0.8/1/1.2. Survey alone earns no physical benefit. No band is converted to a probability.
pfr-pathway-preference.limitations: Coverage is a design-discussion proxy. Equal pathway values and stress multipliers are preferences, not empirically calibrated loss reduction. Suspected drainage/services/floor paths require survey confirmation.

observations.scope: Selected Bewdley resident responses after February 2022; packages varied and some were modified
observations.limitation: Not measured monetary damage reduction, not randomised, not an individual-measure success rate. Descriptive subgroup counts are not exhaustive or forced to sum to 28. Never used as optimisation coefficients.

hazards: River/coastal inundation if site survey confirms pathway

survey.prerequisites: Independent property-level survey of flood sources, thresholds, depth/duration, drainage, fabric and occupant capabilities.
survey.supported_benefit: No direct damage reduction can be assigned to a survey alone.
survey.maintenance: Independent specification, review after change/flood; installation and evacuation plans.
survey.failure_conditions: A survey may rule out all proposed physical works.
survey.depth_note: No universal depth range; design to surveyed flood conditions, construction and services.

barrier.prerequisites: Surveyed fit, certified product design depth, warning, safe deployment, storage and practice.
barrier.supported_benefit: Can limit ingress through protected openings; leakage elsewhere and overtopping remain.
barrier.maintenance: Check seals and fixings, store accessibly, practise deployment and inspect after floods.
barrier.failure_conditions: Insufficient warning, absent occupant, leakage, overtopping, poor fit or structural loading.
barrier.depth_note: Product- and site-specific certified range required. Unknown depth is not zero; resistance above 0.6m is deferred by this conservative screening policy pending bespoke structural design.

hazards: River/coastal inundation if site survey confirms pathway
Surface-water/sewer/groundwater routes require separate site evidence
air-bricks.prerequisites: Confirm vents, floor void and a suitable self-closing system; preserve ventilation.
air-bricks.supported_benefit: Addresses the vent pathway only, not other wall/floor entry routes.
air-bricks.maintenance: Inspect closures and clear debris; retain ventilation and check manufacturer schedule.
air-bricks.failure_conditions: Blocked mechanism, inappropriate ventilation changes, ingress through unprotected routes.
air-bricks.depth_note: Product- and site-specific certified range required. Unknown depth is not zero; resistance above 0.6m is deferred by this conservative screening policy pending bespoke structural design.

flooring.vulnerability: Slow recovery of vulnerable floor finishes
hazards: River/coastal inundation if site survey confirms pathway
Surface-water/sewer/groundwater routes require separate site evidence
flooring.prerequisites: Survey the floor, moisture, contamination and traditional/modern fabric before selecting materials.
flooring.supported_benefit: Suitable recoverable finishes can ease cleaning/drying; substrate and walls may still be damaged.
flooring.maintenance: Inspect finish, joints and substrate; arrange hygienic cleaning and drying after floods.
flooring.failure_conditions: Unsuitable impermeable build-up, groundwater pressure or incompatible historic materials.
flooring.depth_note: No universal depth range; design to surveyed flood conditions, construction and services.
